reason: The claim quotes only half of the row: docs/guides/server/update-compatibility.adoc:132-134 reads "Rolling Upgrade is not possible. The feature `rolling-updates` is disabled.", so code 4 is explicitly tied to the disabled feature and kept apart from the compatibility verdict on code 3 (lines 128-130). Code 4 has no other meaning (CompatibilityResult.java:35, returned only by the feature guard in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:48 and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:48), and the caution at adoc:12-16 already says both commands fail without the feature; what remains is a wording nit.
